attempts.summary: Published node4's HTTP service (port 8080, on lan-b behind node2) on node2's transit address (10.10.2.2) port 80 via OPNsense static-route + firewall pass rules + destination NAT, gave node1 a directly-connected route to that transit address, and confirmed node3 (on lan-a, two hops away via node1) reaches the service by asking node2 rather than addressing node4 directly. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart/recovery protocol on all four nodes with boot-identity proof and post-restart re-verification of the full path.
